conditions: Managed headless browsers; touch-enabled emulation where stated. Scroll offsets are set programmatically, never forced timeline progress. Videos show automated seeks/holds in desktop/mobile/WebKit browsers, not authored playback timing or physical-device recordings. Height-only viewport resize approximates browser chrome and does not verify physical Safari dynamic toolbar behavior. Per-case checks report exact coverage.
